originality.rationale: Lángi’s pre-existing general-convex-body theorem proves the sharp triangle-controlled supremum for every odd side count, with multiple-longest-edge approximants. For polygonal C the claimed finite vertex optimization follows immediately by joint convexity of G_m on C³ and the textbook fact that a convex function on a product polytope achieves a maximum at a vertex. Its finite affine upper envelope, eventual largest-slope diameter phase, and pentagon distance calculation are elementary consequences. This is legitimate and useful specialization but directly implied by stronger prior work plus routine polytope convexity; nonidentical wording is not a new result.
